messages:
olivia: Alert fired - hosted-infer-usw2 p99 latency and elevated 502/504 fraction for the last 6m. Customer complaints coming in. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/hosted-infer-usw2/slo-overview :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Alert: slo.p99.hosted-infer-usw2 > 750ms (6m) | 502/504 rate increased 4x. Alert ID: A-98123
sam: Oncall here. Any deploys or config changes in the last hour? Also check probe vs real traffic gap (traces).
jonah: No deploys. I see a spike in the prefetch queue and a bunch of "kv-cache evicted" logs around the same time. Rough log query I ran: `index=prod source=gateway "kv-cache evicted" | count by host`
sam: Can you paste a quick query for 502s (time window 10m)?
jonah: Sure: ```
# Logs (Splunk-ish)
index=prod service=gateway status=502 OR status=504 | stats count() by upstream_cluster, route, status
```
jonah: Top upstream_cluster is "prefetch-batcher-v2" and route is "/v1/generate".
olivia: Support ticket from cust-4427 includes curl showing 504: ```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
# response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
```
sam: Reproduced locally against staging proxy, getting consistent timeouts on long-tail requests when KV cache miss + cold batch created. Likely contention in batcher + slow upstream wallet (auth) calls.
jonah: I dug traces: lots of root spans from gateway but many requests lack downstream spans (trace gaps). Jaeger sample: https://jaeger.redwood/trace/abcd1234 - shows gateway span then drop.
sam: That trace gap is suspicious — possible sampling/propagation bug at proxy or early timeout. Can we bump probe sampling and enable verbose propagation headers for a short window?
jonah: On it. Pushed temporary config to increase sampling for the gateway and turned on `trace-propagation-debug` on 3 hosts.
infra-bot: Change deployed to 3 hosts in usw2 (config-id cfg-778). No rollback yet.
olivia: Support: passed a temporary workaround to customer — reduced concurrency from client side to 2, which seems to avoid the 504s. Ticket updated: https://support.redwood/t/4427
sam: Meanwhile, let's also check auth token upstream latency. Quick metrics query: `sum(rate(net/http_client_latency_seconds_bucket{service="auth"}[5m])) by (le)` shows a small tail at >1s. If auth spikes, batcher waits and then times out.
jonah: I added a dashboard panel for batcher queue depth and KV miss rate. Early correlation looks strong between kv miss rate rising and 502/504 fraction.
olivia: Any immediate mitigation we can do? Autoscale batcher faster or reduce batch window?
sam: Short-term: reduce batch window from 30ms to 10ms for prefatch-batcher-v2 and add an aggressive KV cache TTL bump to lower miss churn. I'll open a rollout with a canary (1 host) then 25% then full if metrics look good.
jonah: Rolling canary now. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/prefetch-batcher BATCH_WINDOW_MS=10 --namespace=prod-usw2`
infra-bot: Canary started on host h-09c3 (pod prefetch-batcher-v2-09c3). Health checks passing.
support-bot: Customer notified of mitigation and asked to monitor. They reported initial improvement within 3 minutes.
sam: Keep an eye on probe -> real traffic trace coverage. If gaps persist, we may need to instrument early proxy path.
olivia: Noted. I'll keep the ticket open and update every 10m. Thanks team. :heart:
jonah: update @ 5555557000 - canary shows 60% drop in 504s for that host. Scaling canary to 4 hosts.
sam: update @ 5555557150 - p99 trending back towards baseline, 502 fraction halved. I'll continue monitoring for 30m before rolling full.
olivia: Great, marking as in-progress in the incident tracker.
sam: If anyone sees a new spike, ping with trace IDs. Also saving the log queries and the kv eviction counters to the runbook.
jonah: saving notes to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/batcher-kv-eviction
olivia: closing loop — customer replied "latency improved, thanks". Will close ticket after final confirmation.
